headline: Wardens Consolidate Mooring County as Weathered Expanse Bloodshed Surges
war_summary: Since our previous dispatch, Warden arms have completed their sweep of Mooring County, securing all twelve strategic positions as combat in the battered territory sharply cooled. Across Weathered Expanse, however, the contest has erupted into renewed ferocity; casualty rates have surged past a thousand men per hour across both factions, with three Warden and two Colonial strongholds trading ferocious salvos around four ruined no-man's-land tracts near Wightwalk and Frostmarch. Further west, Linn of Mercy has ignited into sudden, intense confrontation, exacting over five hundred casualties in two hours—predominantly among Warden ranks—while Nevish Line and Callahan's Passage endure accelerating gunfire despite immovable trench lines. Meanwhile, the eastern frontlines in Stlican Shelf and Godcrofts have settled into relative calm following earlier clashes, leaving the northern snowfields of Weathered Expanse as the war's primary and most volatile crucible.
